text.description_html:
Kwikset Circa Antique Nickel Privacy Knob

The Circa polished antique nickel privacy knob is distinctive in its beauty and grace. The ball shape lends the perfect finishing touch to any door in any decor be it traditional, modern, or any style in between.

Privacy (bedroom or bathroom): For doors that could need locking. Latch operates from either side. Turnbutton on the middle of the interior knob engages privacy lock on both knobs; emergency release hole is located in the middle of the exterior knob. Complete set - 2 knobs, 2 roses, privacy button, door latch and strike plate.

Specifications of the Kwikset Circa Privacy Knob:

  • Rose Diameter: 2-5/8"
  • Knob Diameter: 2-1/8"
  • Knob Projection: 2-31.32"
  • Easy to install.
  • Manufacture Lifetime Mechanical & Finish Warranty.
  • Finish: Antique Nickel

** Clearance Priced, Non-Returnable item.

Only (1) Left.
